description: Search tours and activities on WizTrip (Hotelbeds activities) in a city, between `from` and `to` (up to 60 days from tomorrow), for travellers of the given `ages` (every traveller, adults included). Activities are not sold alone on wiz-trip.com: they are added when booking a flight, hotel or trip there (or ask Wizzo with trip_chat to add one to the trip).
